title: Algebraic closure in a field extension implies geometric irreducibility
statement: Let $K/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Assume every element of $K$ algebraic over $k$ belongs to $k$ (equivalently, $k$ is algebraically closed in $K$). Then $K/k$ is geometrically irreducible [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible].

proof.text: By [lem-zl-geometric-irreducibility-finite-separable-test], applied to the commutative $k$-algebra $K$, it suffices to prove that $\operatorname{Spec}(K\otimes_kE)$ is irreducible for every finite separable algebraic extension $E/k$. The affine fibre-product identification [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] identifies this spectrum with the base change of $\operatorname{Spec}K$ along $\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}k$; this is the interpretation of geometric irreducibility in [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Fix such $E$.

source.place: Tag 037P proof, opening reduction using Tag 037K

proof.text: Fix a finite separable extension E/k. Use Field.powerBasisOfFiniteOfSeparable from [lem-weil-pbc-finite-separable-extension-primitive-element] to obtain a power basis pb and put P = minpoly k pb.gen. Its monicity and irreducibility follow from integrality. The quotient presentation in [lem-weil-pbc-minimal-polynomial-quotient-field-iso] is implemented by AdjoinRoot.equiv' P pb, identifying AdjoinRoot P with E. Tensor congruence gives K tensor E isomorphic to K tensor AdjoinRoot P. AdjoinRoot.tensorAlgEquiv identifies the latter with AdjoinRoot Q over K tensor k, where Q is P mapped through the right inclusion. Finally TensorProduct.rid k K K identifies K tensor k with K; AdjoinRoot.mapRingEquiv transports the quotient to K[T]/(P_K). The polynomial-map identity follows by map_map and checking the coefficient homomorphisms on each element. These are explicit Mathlib equivalences implementing the tensor universal property [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property].

source.place: Tag 037P (lemma-field-extension-geometrically-irreducible), proof, primitive element and tensor presentation

proof.text: Apply [lem-zl-relative-algebraic-closure-polynomial-quotient-field] to P and the relative algebraic-closedness hypothesis. Its irreducible-spectrum conclusion gives irreducibility of Spec(K[T]/(P_K)). PrimeSpectrum.homeomorphOfRingEquiv for the composite ring equivalence of Step 2 transfers this to Spec(K tensor E), using the spectrum functor [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. The finite-separable criterion and pullbackSpecIso of Step 1 then give geometric irreducibility.
